paragraphs: The X-Type 2.0d uses the ZSD-420 - a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine sourced from Ford. It was fitted from 2003 to 2009 across the X400 generation, representing the diesel entry point to the X-Type range. The ZSD-420 is a belt-driven unit, making the timing belt an interval-service item rather than a failure pattern, but injectors can show wear at higher mileages.
about.boldParagraph: The X-Type 2.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 Diesel engine fitted to the X-Type 2.0d - X400 (2003-2009).
